system.description:
The sorcerer commands the life of fire. He may cause it to burn high and bright or cause it to be low and smoking. This spell affects bonfire-sized fires and smaller. The mage may increase or reduce a fire’s strength by two steps on the natural magic scale. Fires reduced to zero are doused.

Obstacle: 3. Actions: 8.

Origin: Presence | Area of Effect: Single Target/Nat. Effect | Element: Fire | Impetus: Control | Duration: Instantaneous | Resource Points: 6

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 218
